description: A code-first orchestration and observability layer that runs a distributed app locally and can generate deployment artifacts; it is not a production runtime.
The project whose code declares resources (containers, projects) and their references, started with `aspire run`.
AppHost calls that inject a resource's connection information into a project and delay its start until the resource is healthy.
Hosting packages such as `Aspire.Hosting.PostgreSQL` add resources to the AppHost; client packages such as `Aspire.Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL` consume them in the apps.
A template project you own that adds OpenTelemetry, health checks, service discovery and `HttpClient` resilience through `AddServiceDefaults()`.
A developer tool that receives OTLP and shows resources, logs, traces and metrics; also available as a standalone container.
Microsoft supports only the newest Aspire release, so support for a version ends when the next minor or major ships.
